story.title: Protests Over Education Standards Lead to Clashes in France
story.summary: Protests by high school students demanding better education standards and more teachers have led to significant unrest in France. Over 1,000 schools have been affected, with riot police clashing with students, resulting in blockades and the use of tear gas in some areas.

timeline_highlights.title: Protests Erupt in India Demanding Resignation of Election Chief
timeline_highlights.summary: A youth group known as the 'Cockroach' movement has threatened to resume mass protests unless Gyanesh Kumar resigns as head of India's election commission. This demand follows allegations of election rigging, which have also prompted opposition parties, including Congress, to join the protests. Police have responded with tear gas to disperse demonstrators.

timeline_highlights.title: Escalating Student Protests in France Lead to Hundreds of Arrests and Violence
timeline_highlights.summary: Student protests in France have escalated, resulting in violent clashes and widespread unrest. Hundreds have been arrested as demonstrations grow in scale and intensity, with officials noting the involvement of outside agitators. The situation has led to school blockades and numerous injuries among protesters and law enforcement.

timeline_highlights.title: Protests Erupt in Spain as Parliament Rejects Housing Crisis Measures
timeline_highlights.summary: Protests erupted across Spain ahead of a parliamentary vote on housing measures, following the eviction of an 87-year-old woman that sparked public outrage. Hundreds demonstrated in Madrid and other cities, expressing their discontent with the government's handling of the housing crisis. The proposed measures were ultimately rejected by opposition lawmakers, intensifying pressure on the government and raising speculation about a potential snap election.
key_facts: Protests occurred in Madrid and other cities.
Demonstrators expressed outrage over housing issues.
Parliament rejected housing measures proposed by the government.
